GENERAL NOTES: Kate Rockwell's first Elle. Had to record in STLP instead of ST because of space constraints on my dvr, due to the last-minuteness of attending. Act I audio'd from center orch- you can hear a couple of chatty aud members thru Omigod You Guys, I moved my dvr after. Act II audio'd from front row orch- Whipped Into Shape is AWFUL quality, way too instrument heavy, but again I moved my dvr after, the rest of Act II is fine. (Kate Shindle's mic wasn't turned on during the “we girls have to stick together” line in Remix, that's what happened in the dead air there.) Kate Rockwell messed up one line in Chip, and had a delayed entrance from the Chip costume change (Christian Borle had to vamp- “I see...pink...” etc.), otherwise her Elle was brilliant.

MY NOTES: Very nice audio. LOTS of applause, especially at entrances. Laura got a full minute! Cast was having a fun time, doing some random things that they normally wouldn’t. Some different line choices, but most was visual stuff and the only real way to tell is the laughter. Christian doing the bend and snap was incredible (you can hear him drop the file). I don’t think Laura’s “slip up” is that, she thanks DeQuina instead of Pilar right before What You Want. Laura was also having a time singing the ballad, and the “I found my way to love” part of the finale is just sung by Christian. Orfeh riffs most of Ireland (Reprise) and brings back the bone cake line from San Francisco. A very fun listen for fans of the show!

Complete audio of the Original Off-Broadway Cast. This recording has circulated under many different formats over the years. Notable versions include the following.
MP3 (untracked) - 77.2 MB (2 files): Act 1 is mislabeled as Act 2, Act 2 is mislabeled as Act 1. The recording originally sounded slightly sped up. Version circulating has been slowed down, sped back up, and pitch doctored to get rid of the helium effect.
MP3 (tracked) - 95.9 MB (22 files): Audio cuts off after certain tracks, which ends up losing some of the actual audio. Recording seems to be in a higher pitch than normal.
HOWEVER! Recently the untracked copy has been labeled correctly, tracked, and covered to provide the best listening experience possible for this absolute gem of an audio.
